question.prompt:
\(DE\parallel BC\), and \(D\) and \(E\) lie on \(AB\) and \(AC\), respectively. Which pair of similar triangles is shown in the diagram? (In \(\triangle ABC\), \(D\) lies on \(AB\) and \(E\) lies on \(AC\); corresponding vertices are listed in order.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_273_q1_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: Since \(DE\parallel BC\), \(\angle ADE=\angle B\). Also, \(\angle A\) is common, so \(\triangle ADE\sim\triangle ABC\) (A-shaped configuration), with corresponding vertices \(A\leftrightarrow A\), \(D\leftrightarrow B\), and \(E\leftrightarrow C\).
solutions.title: Angle-angle similarity
